visibleCriteria.outcome: Warm golden yellow/cream and turquoise patchwork remains separated and balanced at use size, with orange/brown wood and restrained rope/metal accents. Color gradients reveal volume and material instead of washing into white slabs or muddy dark zones. Preserve palette family without demanding exact target pixels.

Soft broad shading and readable curved edge highlights across cloth hems, rails, knots/ferrules and folded cloth. A single horizontally neutral light/material recipe works inN/E/S/W. No preferred horizontal key, directional ground shadow, black dead spot, blown contour, harsh plastic glare or ImageGen halo.

Cloth has purposeful thickness, gentle sag/folds and restrained seams/stitching; wood has clear rounded construction and warm depth; metal or rope details, if used, have a distinct plausible finish. Useful crafted detail supports silhouette and scale. No mandatory source panel/rail/tie count, no noise added only for enlargement, and no target-image card.
